description: Read or write chrome.storage in a running extension. Every call runs in the extension's background (the engine honours no context), so it proves nothing about what a content script or page can read. A set is read back and the answer says whether the stored value matches. Rides the dev session's control channel, on unless extension_dev was called with allowControl:false. Set one key per call: there is no bulk-object set.

action.description: get reads a key (or the whole area); set writes a key

browser.description: Session browser; defaults to this project's live session. Required when the project runs sessions for more than one browser: the call is refused with the list rather than picking one.

projectPath.description: Extension project root (needs a live dev session)

timeout.description: Command timeout in ms. When omitted, the default depends on the route: 30000 through the dev session's control channel, 10000 over the Firefox debugger protocol, and 15000 per command over the Chromium debug port.

value.description: Value to set (any JSON value); required for action=set

name: extension_storage
